CVE-2026-39883 affects the BSD kenv command invocation in OpenTelemetry's host resource detection. The kenv command is specific to FreeBSD/macOS and does not exist on Linux. The aws-node-termination-handler image runs exclusively in Linux containers, so the vulnerable code path is never executed.
